observations: Photo 0 shows a grey and white sewing machine on a dark table.

The machine has a foot pedal and a matching foot pedal rest.
The machine is positioned in a living room setting with a sofa and curtains in the background.

claims.claim: This sewing machine is in a very good condition, just buy and use.
claims.evidence: The exterior appears clean, but internal mechanical and electrical condition cannot be verified from a photo.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motor may be seized.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine plugged in and the motor running.

risks.risk: The needle or presser foot may be damaged or missing.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the needle plate and the area where the needle is inserted.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken needle plate

risks.risk: The machine may have electrical faults or a burnt-out motor.
risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and the motor running.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and the motor running.
Close-up photo of the needle plate and the area where the needle is inserted.
Photo of the manufacturer's label or specification plate.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
